title: Continuous-Monitoring Continuity Log Entry
description: One record in a topic's continuity log (research-harness-template#421): reports/<topic>/monitoring/continuity-log.jsonl, one JSON object per line, append-only. An explicitly scoped extension distinct from schemas/findings.schema.json (per Story #421's own acceptance criteria) rather than a MIF finding: an ingestion failure, a budget breach, or an Editorial Gate rejection is operational telemetry, not a research finding, and forcing it through the finding shape's citation/ontology-entity-type machinery would misrepresent it as one. Still git-native under reports/<topic>/ per NFR7.
